name: Pilgrim Peeling Solution | Weekend Facial Peel for Deep Cleansing & Exfoliation | Radiant & Even-Toned Skin | For Men & Women | 30ml
description:
Reveal smoother and brighter-looking skin with the Pilgrim 32% AHA BHA PHA Peeling Solution, an advanced exfoliating facial peel formulated with a powerful blend of 25% AHA, 2% BHA, and 5% PHA. This lightweight, rinse-off solution helps remove dead skin cells, unclog pores, and improve overall skin texture for a refreshed and radiant appearance. Designed as a quick 10-minute weekend facial, this peeling solution combines Glycolic Acid, Lactic Acid, and Salicylic Acid to deeply cleanse the skin and promote a more even-looking complexion. Suitable for men and women, its fast-absorbing formula supports smoother, healthier-looking skin with regular use.

Key Features
Powerful blend of 25% AHA, 2% BHA, and 5% PHA
Helps exfoliate dead skin cells and impurities
Supports brighter and more even-looking skin
Deeply cleanses pores and removes excess oil
Helps improve skin texture and smoothness
Lightweight, fast-absorbing liquid formula
Quick 10-minute rinse-off facial peel
Suitable for men and women
Supports skin cell renewal
Suitable for normal, oily, dry, combination, and sensitive skin

Brand: Pilgrim

Net Volume: 30ml (1.01 Fl Oz)

How to Use
Cleanse and dry your face thoroughly
Apply a thin layer to the face, avoiding the eye area
Leave on for 10 minutes only
Rinse thoroughly with water
Follow with a moisturizer
Use once a week or as needed

Material / Composition
Glycolic Acid (AHA)
Lactic Acid (AHA)
Salicylic Acid (BHA)
Poly Hydroxy Acids (PHA)
Alpha Hydroxy Acids (AHA)
Beta Hydroxy Acids (BHA)

Safety Information
For external use only
Avoid contact with eyes and lips
Do not use on irritated or damaged skin
Perform a patch test before first use
Use sunscreen during the day after application
Discontinue use if irritation occurs
Keep out of reach of children
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
